meta.name: custom-skill-builder
meta.description: Create or update user-defined skills for Codex, Claude Code, and local agent workspaces. Use when the user wants a new reusable skill, a project-specific skill, a team workflow skill, a tool-integration skill, a domain-knowledge skill, or a revision of an existing skill with proper frontmatter, concise instructions, references, agent metadata, routing integration, and validation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把常用操作变成可复用的自定义技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常在 AI 编码助手中定制可复用的工作流。
copy.tagline_en: Turn recurring workflows into reusable custom skills
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often create reusable instructions for AI coding assistants.

howto.what: 当用户要求创建或更新可复用技能时，Claude会按流程操作：先审阅技能编写规范并确认用途，检查是否已有类似技能，然后生成包含触发条件和操作步骤的SKILL.md、配置文件、路由记录等，最后验证并给出测试示例。
howto.when: 当用户要求新建或修改某个可复用技能，例如项目专用、团队工作流、工具集成等技能，或要求为Codex、Claude Code等agent配置技能时触发。

say.text: 帮我建一个整理每日周报的技能
say.note: Claude会按流程生成技能文件

say.text: 把这个技能改成只在提到代码审查时触发
say.note: 会调整技能描述和路由

say.text: 给这个技能加一个处理Markdown的脚本

howto.what_en: When the user asks to create or update a reusable skill, Claude reviews the contract, clarifies intent, checks overlaps, then creates SKILL.md, metadata, and routing, and validates with a forward test.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to create or modify a reusable skill, e.g. project-specific, team workflow, tool-integration, or update an existing skill for Codex or Claude Code.

say_en.text: Create a skill for organizing daily reports.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the skill files.

say_en.text: Change this skill to trigger only on code review.
say_en.note: It will update description and routing.

say_en.text: Add a script that processes Markdown to this skill.
say_en.note: It will add scripts and update references.
